title: Evidence Model Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema that all variant evidence models must validate against. Every evidence model in templates/<variant>/evidence-models/** must declare a draft-07 JSON Schema and include all required top-level fields. Generalizes the co-safety evidence-models pattern. See design §8.2 and ADR-0083.

$schema.description: JSON Schema dialect. Must be draft-07.

$id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence model schema (e.g. 'tbm-record.schema.json').

title.description: Human-readable title of the evidence model.

description.description: Detailed description of what records this evidence model captures.

version.description: Semantic version (e.g. 1.2.0) of this evidence model.

required.description: List of required properties. Must include 'record_id' to satisfy the meta-schema requirement.

properties.description: Object describing all properties of the evidence record.

pattern.description: Regex pattern that record_id values must match (e.g. '^REC-[0-9]{6}$').

record_id.description: The record_id property, required in all evidence models. Provides a unique identifier for each evidence record.

additionalProperties.description: Additional properties are permitted to support domain-specific extensions.
